scope: Scoped port pass only: exam-structure claims, required-practical numbers, tier wrappers, paper allocation, board naming. Facts were checked earlier the same day.

findings.claim: The whole of content_html sits inside <div class="higher-only">, so body.tier-foundation hides the entire lesson.
findings.truth: Moments, levers and gears is 4.5.4 (physics only) and is core in GCSE Physics; the moment equation M = F x d is a recall equation with no HT flag. Only 4.5.7 Momentum is (HT only), together with the sheet equation force = change in momentum / time (3 HT). Unwrap the lesson and re-wrap from the Momentum heading to the end.
findings.evidence: spec 4.5.4 heading carries (physics only) and no (HT only); 4.5.7 Momentum (HT only); Appendix A recall equation 4 unflagged, sheet equation 3 flagged HT.

findings.claim: The whole of content_html sits inside <div class="higher-only">, so a Foundation student sees an empty lesson.
findings.truth: Reflection of waves is 4.6.1.3 (physics only) with no HT flag, so the law of reflection, ray diagrams and specular/diffuse reflection are core. 4.6.1.4 Sound waves and 4.6.1.5 Waves for detection and exploration are both (HT only). Unwrap, re-wrap from the Sound Waves heading, and move the lesson diagram above the wrapper so Foundation students keep it.
findings.evidence: spec 4.6.1.3 (physics only); 4.6.1.4 (physics only) (HT only); 4.6.1.5 (physics only) (HT only).

findings.truth: The validator limit is 100 characters. Shortened to 96 characters with the same meaning.

findings.claim: The higher-only wrapper covers the whole 'Temperature, Radiation, and the Earth' box, including the statement that the intensity and wavelength of emitted radiation depend on temperature.
findings.truth: In 4.6.3.2 the statement that emission intensity and wavelength distribution depend on temperature is core. Only the thermal-equilibrium statement and the temperature of the Earth carry (HT only). Tighten the wrapper to the last two paragraphs.
findings.evidence: spec 4.6.3.2: core bullet 'the intensity and wavelength distribution of any emission depends on the temperature of the body'; the following three statements each open (HT only).

findings.claim: The whole lesson is wrapped higher-only, and the brief expected wording that places transformers on Paper 1.
findings.truth: The wrapper is correct: 4.7.3 Induced potential, transformers and the National Grid is (physics only) (HT only) throughout, and loudspeakers are 4.7.2.4 (physics only) (HT only). No sentence anywhere in the lesson names a paper, so there is nothing to change to 'Paper 2'. Transformers do sit in topic 7, which Paper 2 assesses. A Foundation student will see this lesson as empty, which is right for the spec but worth Tom knowing.
findings.evidence: spec 4.7.3 heading and 4.7.3.1-4.7.3.4 all (HT only); 4.7.2.4 Loudspeakers (physics only) (HT only); assessment section: Paper 2 assesses topics 5-8.

findings.claim: The second higher-only wrapper holds one narration block (n19) that mixes core velocity-time graph shapes with the HT-only area-under-the-graph method; the bullet n18 'The area under the line gives the distance travelled' sits outside any wrapper although it is HT only.
findings.truth: Splitting n19 would add or remove a data-narration-id block, which the edit rules forbid, and wrapping a single <li> inside a <ul> needs a restructure. Options: leave as is (Foundation loses two core sentences, gains one HT sentence), or rebuild the section with a fresh narration split. Same in the source combined lesson, so this is pre-existing, not a port error.
findings.evidence: spec 4.5.6.1.5: 'The acceleration of an object can be calculated from the gradient of a velocity-time graph' is core; '(HT only) The distance travelled ... from the area under a velocity-time graph'.

findings.claim: Expected combined-science exam-structure wording, required-practical numbers and 'separate science only' sentences.
findings.truth: None exist. No lesson names a number of papers, a duration, a mark total, 'Combined Science' or 'Trilogy'; no lesson cites a required-practical number (lesson 2 and lesson 6 name their practicals in words only, and both match the physics list at 6 and 8); no lesson names an exam board; no sentence says a topic is not on the course. Lesson 7 already says 'In Physics Paper 2', which is right because EM waves are topic 6. Lesson 2's claim that elastic potential energy is given on the equation sheet is correct.
findings.evidence: grep over all 13 raw files for combined/trilogy/70 marks/1 hour 15/paper/required practical/board names/not on your course; spec Appendix A sheet equation 4.

findings.claim: Higher wrappers in the eight copied lessons.
findings.truth: All verified correct against the physics spec: lesson 1 free body diagrams (4.5.1.4 HT only), lesson 3 tangent to a distance-time curve (4.5.6.1.4 HT only), lesson 4 inertia and inertial mass (4.5.6.2.1 and 4.5.6.2.2 HT only), lesson 5 momentum (4.5.7 HT only), lesson 8 motor effect, Fleming's left-hand rule and electric motors (4.7.2.2 and 4.7.2.3 HT only). Lesson 13 needs no wrapper: it does not teach the (HT only) orbital-motion statements in 4.8.1.3.
findings.evidence: spec section headings and (HT only) markers listed above.

summary: Lessons 9 and 10 had the whole lesson inside a higher-only wrapper, which hid core physics-only content from Foundation students; both unwrapped and re-wrapped at the genuine HT boundary (momentum, and sound waves onwards). Lesson 11's wrapper was tightened to the two (HT only) statements. Lesson 12's whole-lesson wrapper is correct because 4.7.3 is HT only throughout. No combined-science exam-structure claim, required-practical number, board name or 'not on your course' sentence exists anywhere in the unit.
